channel.title: Figma incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Figma's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Figma MCP Disruption [resolved]
item.description: The issue preventing some Codex and ChatGPT users from seeing MCP tools, such as use_figma, has been resolved. The impact began at 10:14 UTC, with recovery beginning at 14:03 UTC.

item.title: Figma Make and Agent Service Disruption [resolved]
item.description: We've identified an issue leading to errors while prompting Figma Make and and Agent using Anthropic models. This has been resolved.

item.title: Figma Make Service Disruption [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved at 9:39 am UTC

item.title: Figma Make Publishing Disruption [resolved]
item.description: From 12:45 to 4:50 PM UTC today, we experienced an issue that prevented some users from previewing and publishing Figma Make files. We have updated this from Monitoring to Resolved.

item.title: Variant Properties Disruption [resolved]
item.description: From 5:50PM 3/6 UTC to 1:15AM 3/7 UTC, there was a bug that would cause library publishes to be incorrect. Files pulling in those updates would experience errors related to conflicting properties in variants. The issue with library publishes has been resolved. If you continue to see this error, please re-publish the affected components (by making a small change) and re-update the consuming files to apply the fix.

item.title: Figma Sites Publishing Disruption [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved as of February 17 at 18:59 UTC.

item.title: Figma Make Publishing Disruption [resolved]
item.description: From 7:05 PM UTC on Feb 5 to 12:00 AM UTC on Feb 6, some users experienced issues when prompting in Figma Make or Sites with code components. This issue has been resolved.

item.title: Figma Make Publishing Disruption [resolved]
item.description: From 9:58 PM UTC on Jan 27 to 2:00 AM UTC on Feb 1, some users experienced issues when prompting in Figma Make or Sites with code components. This issue has been resolved.

item.title: Figma Make service disruption [resolved]
item.description: From 12AM to 5PM UTC, some users experienced issues while prompting in Figma Make. This has been resolved.

item.title: Figma Make publishing disruption [resolved]
item.description: From 5:30 PM to 6:30 PM UTC, some users were experiencing issues when publishing Figma Make files or publishing Sites. This has been resolved.

item.title: Figma Make Service Disruption [resolved]
item.description: From 06:30 UTC to 17:20 UTC, Figma Make was experiencing intermittent errors building Make files. A fix has been implemented in Figma Make and this incident is now resolved.

item.title: Service Disruption with Sites and Make [resolved]
Figma service disruption [resolved]
item.description: From 19:38 UTC to 4:10 UTC, Figma was degraded or unavailable due to failures in AWS and other dependencies. We've completed all mitigations and have been monitoring the situation for a few hours now without issues. We haven't seen any abnormal issues since our 4:10 UTC update, so we are marking the incident resolved. We will continue to monitor closely through the night.

item.title: Figma Make service disruption [resolved]
item.description: From 19:00 to 21:51 UTC, some users experienced issues while prompting in Figma Make. This has been resolved.

item.title: Mobile prototyping disruption for iOS [resolved]
item.description: A fix has been implemented and prototypes and Mirror on iOS should now be operational. We are continuing to monitor.
